title: Cloud Architect
description: Master cloud fundamentals, advanced architecture patterns, secure networking, robust security, high reliability, performance optimization, cost management, and strategic migration planning across leading cloud providers.

tree.name: Cloud Foundations & Core Services
tree.description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of cloud computing models, global infrastructure, core compute, storage, networking, and identity services, along with pricing, the shared responsibility model, and foundational monitoring practices.

children.name: Cloud Computing Concepts
children.description: Explore IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, serverless, public, private, and hybrid cloud models, their benefits, and challenges. Understand fundamental concepts like virtualization, containers, and serverless computing paradigms.

resources.title: What is IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS?

children.name: Global Infrastructure & Shared Responsibility
children.description: Understand cloud provider global infrastructure including regions, availability zones, and edge locations. Deep dive into the shared responsibility model, clearly defining customer and provider obligations for security and compliance.

children.name: Core Compute Services
children.description: Compare IaaS (VMs, bare metal), PaaS (App Services, Elastic Beanstalk), containers (ECS, EKS, AKS, GKE, Cloud Run), and FaaS (Lambda, Azure Functions, Cloud Functions). Understand their lifecycle management, scaling, and specific use cases, including fundamental container orchestration concepts with Kubernetes and introduction to service mesh concepts.

children.name: Core Storage & Data Services
children.description: Differentiate between object storage (S3, Blob Storage, Cloud Storage), block storage (EBS, Azure Disks, Persistent Disk), file storage (EFS, Azure Files, Filestore), and backup/archive solutions (Glacier, Azure Archive). Explore managed database services including relational (RDS, Azure SQL), NoSQL (DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), data warehouses (Redshift, Synapse), and data lakes.

children.name: Core Networking Fundamentals
children.description: Understand basic cloud networking concepts: Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs)/Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets (public/private), IP addressing, route tables, network gateways (Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway), and basic load balancing (L4). Learn about DNS resolution fundamentals (Route 53, Azure DNS, Cloud DNS) and network security groups (NSGs).

children.name: Identity & Access Management (IAM)
children.description: Design least-privilege roles, policies, service accounts, and integrate with enterprise identity providers (Active Directory, Okta). Implement federated identity, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), conditional access, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and temporary/just-in-time credentials. Understand secrets management (Secrets Manager, Key Vault) and privileged access management (PAM) principles.

children.name: Cloud Economics & FinOps Fundamentals
children.description: Understand cloud pricing models (on-demand, reserved instances, savings plans, spot instances), cost calculators, budgets, alerts, and basic Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis. Introduce FinOps principles (Inform, Optimize, Operate), including fundamental concepts of cost allocation, chargeback, and showback.

children.name: Monitoring & Logging Fundamentals
children.description: Configure essential metrics, logs, and alarms for basic system health monitoring. Design effective dashboards and basic alerting strategies. Utilize cloud-native tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Cloud Monitoring) for initial observability setups. Understand structured logging and basic log aggregation.

resources.title: AWS CloudWatch Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course

tree.name: Cloud Networking & Security
tree.description: Design secure, resilient, and high-performance network architectures, implementing comprehensive security controls and compliance practices across various cloud providers.

children.name: Advanced VPC/VNet Design & Connectivity
children.description: Plan multi-VPC/VNet architectures, CIDR ranges, public/private subnets, network gateways (Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway), advanced routing, VPC peering, Transit Gateways/Hub-and-Spoke, and hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect). Implement various load balancing types (ALB, NLB, Azure Load Balancer, Google Load Balancer, Global Load Balancer) and robust network segmentation strategies.

children.name: Advanced Network Security Controls
children.description: Implement Security Groups, Network ACLs, cloud-native firewalls (e.g., AWS Network Firewall, Azure Firewall, Cloud Firewall), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) protection, VPNs, Endpoint Security, and Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS). Secure API Gateways, microservices communication, and implement perimeter defenses using next-generation firewalls and security appliances.

children.name: Data Protection, Encryption & Lifecycle Management
children.description: Apply encryption at rest and in transit using industry best practices. Utilize key management services (KMS, Key Vault, Cloud KMS) for cryptographic key generation, storage, and rotation. Implement secrets management for application credentials. Understand data residency, data classification, data loss prevention (DLP), and data lifecycle management policies for compliance.

resources.title: Cloud Computing Security Tutorial for Beginners
Cloud Security Explained - A free course from Google Cloud

children.name: Application Security in Cloud
children.description: Implement security best practices for cloud-native applications, including secure coding principles, API security gateways, container image scanning and runtime protection, serverless function security, and supply chain security for CI/CD pipelines. Address common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10) in cloud environments.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 Explained - Web Application Security Tutorial

children.name: Security Governance, Risk & Compliance
children.description: Understand industry compliance standards (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001), regulatory requirements, audit logging, and security policy enforcement. Implement Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection Platforms (CWPP), and security automation. Introduce threat modeling, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)/Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) concepts, and continuous compliance frameworks.

children.name: Network Automation & Policy as Code
children.description: Automate network configuration and policy enforcement using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or cloud-native IaC for networking. Implement Policy as Code (PaC) for security and compliance across network resources. Explore network service mesh concepts and their role in microservices networking, traffic management, and security policies.

resources.title: Introduction to Network Policy in Kubernetes
Terraform Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course
Service Mesh Explained - Istio, Linkerd, and more

tree.name: Reliability, Performance, & Cost Optimization
tree.description: Implement architectural patterns for high availability, disaster recovery, performance scaling, comprehensive observability, and effective cost management to ensure robust and efficient cloud solutions.

children.name: High Availability & Disaster Recovery
children.description: Design multi-AZ/multi-region systems, implement auto-scaling, advanced load balancing, backups, snapshotting, and replication strategies for databases and storage. Define and achieve stringent Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) objectives. Develop comprehensive failover/failback strategies, implement graceful degradation, and employ chaos engineering principles to proactively test system resilience.

resources.title: Google Cloud Disaster Recovery Planning Guide

children.name: Performance, Scalability & Optimization
children.description: Implement advanced caching strategies (CDN, in-memory caches like Redis, Memcached, serverless caching). Optimize database performance, fine-tune queries, implement read replicas and sharding. Address serverless cold start optimization, optimize container image sizes, and ensure efficient network performance (e.g., using private endpoints, faster interconnects). Explore edge computing, content delivery strategies, and performance benchmarking.

resources.title: System Design Interview Course - Learn how to design large scale systems

children.name: Advanced Observability & Distributed Tracing
children.description: Implement advanced observability practices including distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin), correlation IDs, advanced log analysis, and custom metrics. Design sophisticated alerting and notification systems, and integrate with incident management platforms. Explore AIOps concepts, synthetic monitoring, and Real User Monitoring (RUM) for a holistic view of system performance and user experience.

resources.title: Observability 101: Understanding Your Systems in a Cloud-Native World
Distributed Tracing with OpenTelemetry for Beginners

children.name: Cost Management & Advanced FinOps
children.description: Deep dive into cloud cost estimation, advanced right-sizing resources, implementing budgets with automated actions, and detecting resource waste. Leverage Reserved Instances/Savings Plans, Spot Instances, and enterprise discount programs. Implement advanced FinOps practices including chargeback/showback, cost allocation tags, anomaly detection, forecasting, and continuous cost optimization loops aligned with business value.

resources.title: What is FinOps? | FREE FinOps Training
Cloud Cost Optimization Tutorial - AWS, Azure, GCP

children.name: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Principles for Cloud
children.description: Apply SRE principles like error budgets, Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and post-mortems to improve cloud system reliability. Implement practices for incident management, on-call rotations, automation for operational tasks, and proactive problem solving through blameless post-mortems and continuous improvement cycles.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Full Course for Beginners
What is SRE? Site Reliability Engineering Explained

tree.name: Cloud Architecture Design & Practice
tree.description: Master the art of designing, documenting, and implementing robust cloud architectures, including strategic migration planning, robust governance, and seamless DevOps integration.

resources.title: AWS Solutions Architect Associate Full Course (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Cloud Architecture Patterns & Design Principles
children.description: Explore common cloud architecture patterns (microservices, event-driven architectures, serverless, N-tier, data mesh, data lakes, streaming architectures) and advanced design principles for scalability, resilience, fault tolerance, loose coupling, and maintainability. Introduce enterprise integration patterns, advanced data architecture patterns (e.g., data virtualization, data fabric), and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in cloud contexts.

children.name: Infrastructure as Code & Cloud DevOps
children.description: Model cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure Resource Manager (ARM Templates), or Google Cloud Deployment Manager. Integrate IaC into CI/CD pipelines, implement GitOps for declarative infrastructure management, and automate deployments. Understand container orchestration with Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) and configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet). Implement Policy as Code (PaC) using tools like Open Policy Agent (OPA) or cloud-native guardrails for continuous compliance and security.

resources.title: DevOps Course for Beginners | Learn DevOps in 10 Hours
Terraform Course for Beginners - Learn Terraform in 3.5 Hours

children.name: Cloud Migration & Modernization Strategies
children.description: Understand the 6 R's of migration (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Repurchase, Retain, Retire) and advanced migration strategies. Evaluate different migration tools and services (AWS Migration Hub, Azure Migrate, Google Cloud Migrate for Compute Engine). Develop comprehensive migration plans, conduct thorough application assessments, execute phased migrations, and perform post-migration optimization and modernization, including re-architecture considerations for cloud-native adoption.

resources.title: Cloud Migration Explained - The 6 R's of Cloud Migration (Rehost, Replatform, Rearchitect, Repurchase, Retire, Retain)

children.name: Architecture Documentation & Communication
children.description: Conduct effective architecture design reviews, document architectural decisions using Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), create clear architecture diagrams (e.g., C4 model, UML, ArchiMate), and communicate complex designs to diverse stakeholders (technical and non-technical) effectively through presentations and written reports. Develop skills in technical leadership, influencing, negotiation, and articulating business value of architectural decisions.

resources.title: The C4 Model for Software Architecture
The C4 Model for Software Architecture Explained in 7 Minutes

children.name: Cloud Governance & Enterprise Strategy
children.description: Develop and implement comprehensive cloud governance frameworks including policy enforcement, resource tagging strategies, cost allocation, security baselines, and service catalog management. Understand multi-account/multi-subscription strategies and organizational best practices for large-scale cloud adoption. Integrate with enterprise architecture roadmaps, manage organizational change, and establish a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) to drive cloud adoption and innovation.

resources.title: What is a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE)?

children.name: Capstone Project: End-to-End Cloud Solution Design
children.description: Apply all learned principles to design a secure, scalable, highly available, performant, and cost-optimized end-to-end cloud product architecture. This includes gathering requirements, creating detailed architecture diagrams, developing an IaC skeleton, defining a comprehensive DR plan, and presenting the solution to technical and business stakeholders, justifying architectural decisions and trade-offs.

resources.title: Google Cloud Architecture Framework: Case Studies
AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate 2024 (PASS THE EXAM!)
System Design Interview Course - Learn how to design large-scale systems
